title: Systematicity of students’ independent work in the course of operating systems
reason: Re-extraction. Moodle Assignment submission timing (share of 11 reports submitted on time) correlated with final written test result, Pearson r = 0.28, n = 54. Table 2 row confirmed.

extraction.country: Ukraine (Simon Kuznets Kharkiv National University of Economics)
extraction.n_quote: In total, ... 54 students took part in experiment. 274 reports were ... analysed.
extraction.population: second-year computer science and software engineering bachelor students, Operating Systems course, 1 university
extraction.lms_indicators: systematicity indicator = number of Moodle Assignment reports submitted on time / 11 planned reports; submission timestamps (day before deadline, hour of day)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: final written test result (ratio to maximal score)

effect_sizes.between: share of reports submitted on time ↔ final test result
effect_sizes.quote: Pearson correlation between these two ... variables is 0.28. This correlation is statistically ... significant at the significance level 5% for samples size ... of 54

extraction.notes: Two-column PDF; quote fragments joined with ' ... '. No p-value or CI beyond 'significant at the significance level 5%'. Authors read the indicator as related to self-management but do not measure a personality construct (I2 not met). Republished with identical data in Ukr. J. Educ. Stud. Inf. Technol. 2022, 10(4) (OUCI-004, excluded E2). First author is a co-author of the manuscript under review.
